assumptions: The connected repository contains the product's source; public docs may or may not be in it.
Coverage is judged from repository content only, so docs hosted elsewhere show as uncovered.
cost_drivers: Repository size up to the workspace file limit, the focus input, up to ten web searches, and pages_to_draft.
effects: Reads the connected GitHub repository and writes reports/ERROR_PAGES.md in this project. Publishes nothing and changes no code.

cases.description: A repository with a CLI and docs: rank user-visible errors and draft the top three pages.
Empty docs_base_url must leave a visible placeholder, not invent a domain.

rubric.question: Does each inventory anchor match the literal text at its cited path:line?
Is every cause in a drafted page backed by a cited condition in code, with guesses kept under Not confirmed?
Do the scores equal reach × gap × self_fixable per SCORING.md, and is nothing with gap 0 drafted?
Are unrun searches marked not_checked rather than none, and do third_party or competitor entries cite a URL?
Does each link-back diff change one line and keep the original wording?
